Results.ReviewText: This is my third Original kettle grill I have owned (+/- 20 yrs each). There has been some great improvements to the design.  Putting it together was a breeze and straight forward.  My first grilling on this was a bit of a disappointment as the grill surface was quickly out of level - each line was still straight with each other but were out of level up and down making it difficult to remove delicate items like fish.  A spatula will sever the middle of a piece of salmon as the middle is now sitting lower than the sides.  Yes, designs have tried to keep within a price range but this particular piece should not be value engineered to such a drastic degree.
Results.Title: Kettle Grill: Improvements and not so much

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill for my husband for Father's Day.  The kettle type grill takes us back to the 80s when we were growing up.  Very easy to assemble and extremely sturdy. Cooks evenly and the clean up is a breeze.  Plus, the 10 year warranty can't be beat!!
Results.Title: Excellent grill!

Results.ReviewText: I like my original kettle grill.  You need a better way to hang lid other than on the side. It misses its hook often. Also, need a much better way to keep wheels on axle. Hard to pound on the small caps straight without them popping off or mashing fingers as you start to hammer on
Results.Title: Not too bad...

Results.ReviewText: Weber quality. There is nothing better. You get what you pay for.
Results.Title: A+

Results.ReviewText: I had an 18" charcoal grill and after 15 years of regular use, it looked almost new.  However, with my growing family, I needed more space, so I got this one as a Father's Day gift.  It looks to be just as solid as my old one, with more grill space.
Results.Title: Solid Grill

Results.ReviewText: I got this grill just only 1month ago and I love it. Got a charcoal chimney too, so I don't have to use fluid.  So easy, so much better flavour than my old propane bbq. And I absolutely love the classic kettle look. Wish I could get the star spangled flag version.
Results.Title: Much bbq. Very grill. So flavour. Wow!

Results.ReviewText: When I bought my first house I knew my first purchase was a 22 in Weber! Boy I’m so glad I did, this is the OG of grilling. Get a chimney, hardwood and a natural igniter! Let the good flavors flow through you! My wife can’t put down all the meat I’m grilling, it’s been an out of body experience!
Results.Title: Change your life now!

Results.ReviewText: ive used it only one time since the purchase but I really enjoyed the experience looking forward to using it for the Fourth of July!!

Results.ReviewText: This grill cooks great.  That's the main reason I bought it and I cant complain about that at all. However, the pull handle and wheels could be better designed.  First time I rolled the grill from my garage to the patio, the lid fell off causing a dent and chipped the paint.  I think the handle should be on the other side so you tilt the unit TOWARDS the wheels when rolling it around.  Short of putting a bungee on the lid or some kind of lock, now I just take the lid off and carry it separately.  Larger wheels might help too.
Results.Title: Cooks great, handle and wheels could be better

Results.ReviewText: Fast, packed well, and excellent quality.  Assemble would have been easier if the two support legs were identified with a number or letter that would also match the kettle leg inserts so they are put in and line up properly.

Results.ReviewText: My wife bought me a 18" grill 20 years ago for my birthday. Well it was time to upgrade in size. So, I recently purchased the 22". So, happy! So much more room. Weber is the best in my opinion.

Results.Title: Most versatile grill

Results.ReviewText:
Haven't tried it quite yet. But my wife and I used our old one for about 40 years and were looking forward to more ... until our snow-removal guy ran his plow into it last winter. (My fault; I left it in the way.) So I expect we'll love using this one, almost identical, for years to come. Anxious to see how the "new" (to us) heat shield on the upper handle works.

One suggested design improvement: Add a small hole at the bottom of the ash-catcher bowl, so rainwater can drain out between uses - perhaps with a rotating hole cover underneath, for when no hole is wanted.
Results.Title: Near Perfection!
